text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
HBD, Palmer!! It's a super celebratory 
anniversary, so for now, let's get hyped 
and party hard together, whoooo!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Ayyy! Thanks, Helios! Let's get hyped 
together!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
"Come to think of it~ does the Mejiro 
family throw b-day parties?"

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
That would be insane! Totally nuts~! 
Wouldn't that be, like, god-tier 
gorgeous!?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
I don't know about "godly gorgeous," but 
they'll definitely celebrate with you.

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Then how about we throw a super flashy 
party night!? Whole Mejiro family 
gathering, whoo-hoo!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Oh, that's a great idea! Though it might 
give Grandmother quite a shock!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Still, I really wanna introduce you, 
Helios! Come over and hang out at the 
Mejiro estate!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Aww... Palmer...! You really are the best 
bestie ever!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
"Roger roger, gotcha covered! I'm gonna 
bring the hype so you'll never forget me, 
so let's get it, whoooo!"
